name: Particle Field
description: Full-screen black canvas where glowing particles are born on a grid, climb a radial field toward the center and leave fading colored trails.
contents: Full-viewport canvas with a black background and animated particle trails
behavior: Particles spawn at random grid points and hop toward higher field values around the center
Trails fade through a translucent black overlay each frame
Hue slowly cycles over time when particleColor is hue
editableByProps: Particle count, spawn rate, lifespan, grid density, zoom
Particle color: cycling hue or a fixed hue value

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the background color and trail fade

needsCodeEdit.where: birth function particle object (hue, sat, lum)

fixed: Canvas is sized to the window, not the container, and is always full-screen height
